questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: It was a great opportunity to do a shorter exchange program. Also it was very important and interesting to do exchange in another nordic country.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: The registration was easy. We registred through quides provided by a mail we recived.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The response from the University of Reykjavik was fast, so when we were in doubt, the help was quick.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was similar but we focused a lot more on group discussions and trips.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. The city of Reykjavik is a very, very safe but expensive city
2. The teachings are intimate so it is very good exercise in group discussions and academic or educational activity
3. Remember to visit other places than just Reykjavik. I learned a great deal from also visiting the nature and the historical sites as well as the teachings in the classroom

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: You should be prepared, that it is an expensive country

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The most rewarding part was to meet the other students from other countries.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Because there af only buses in Reykjavik and no trains in the country, you depend on others to travels around if you want to explore anything else
